auth.scheme: PHP session cookie set by a form login

csrf.note: the token must be read from the login page in the same session; a POST without it is rejected.

users.note: the public demo publishes Admin / admin123

auth.note: No token flow exists. A CSRF-bearing form POST is the only way in, which is why this app logs in once through the UI and reuses the saved session.
